description: HTTP framework for V with its own engine: one SO_REUSEPORT epoll worker per CPU, pipelined responses batched into one write, and no allocation per request inside the framework (CI-enforced). Router with :params, middleware chain (c.next()), compile-time JSON encoder, gzip middleware on its own DEFLATE encoder, static files with ETag, ranges and precompressed .br/.gz copies. TLS 1.3 on the same workers: the common handshake (X25519, RSA-PSS) and the AES-GCM records on its own code, the rest on mbedtls, the TLS library V ships; certificates reloaded when the files change. HTTP/2 on the same workers and through the same router and Ctx: over TLS by ALPN and cleartext with prior knowledge, its own HPACK, flow control and RFC 9113 limits. WebSocket (RFC 6455) on the same workers, messages handed over as views into the read buffer. Request framing is smuggling-hardened (Content-Length and chunked) and fuzzed in CI. Default configuration.
